scope: Internal-network operating instructions; documentation changes only.

cli_help.stdout:
usage: python -m ai_sdlc_workbench.coverage_suite [-h] --config CONFIG
                                                  [--mode {replay,live}]
                                                  [--output OUTPUT]
                                                  [--user-limit USER_LIMIT]
                                                  [--open]

Run configured permission comparisons and produce one linked coverage report.
Supplied response replay is the default. Live collection requires --mode live.
Each comparison retains its own scope, denominator, checkpoints, and evidence.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --mode {replay,live}
  --output OUTPUT
  --user-limit USER_LIMIT
  --open

usage: offline.py prepare [-h] --output OUTPUT [--core-only]
                          [--download-timeout DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT]

options:

  --output OUTPUT
